startups.title: 50 Startups: Multiple Linear Regression & Feature Selection Explorer
startups.hero_desc: Compare 5 Machine Learning Feature Selection Algorithms (Lasso, Forward SFS, RFE, ElasticNet, Exhaustive Search) against Baseline OLS. Explore the bias-variance tradeoff across feature counts (k=1 to 5), pinpointing the 2-feature optimal sweet spot and the 5-feature overfitting cliff.
startups.sweet_spot_note: Occam's Razor: 2 features yield the minimum test RMSE ($8,198.80) and peak R² (0.9474).
startups.overfitting_note: Overfitting Warning: Adding Administration & Location dummies spikes error to $9,137.99!

real_estate.title: Taiwan Real Estate: Property Valuation & Multiple Regression Explorer
real_estate.hero_title: Taiwan Real Estate Valuation & Amenity Parsimony
real_estate.hero_desc: Analyze Taiwan housing price per unit area (10,000 NTD/Ping) across Taipei/New Taipei districts. Compare 5 Feature Selection Algorithms against OLS to uncover how Distance to MRT, Convenience Stores, and House Age govern housing market values.
real_estate.sweet_spot_note: Occam's Razor: 3 features (Distance to MRT, Convenience Stores, House Age) minimize prediction error without geographical collinearity.
real_estate.overfitting_note: Collinearity Alert: Adding Latitude & Longitude coordinates creates spatial collinearity and increases variance.

insurance.title: Medical Healthcare Cost: Multiple Linear Regression & Risk Explorer
insurance.hero_title: Health Insurance Charges & Actuarial Risk Selection
insurance.hero_desc: Evaluate patient demographic and risk attributes (Smoker status, BMI, Age, Children, Region) predicting medical insurance bills. Benchmark 5 Feature Selection Algorithms to identify core actuarial drivers.
insurance.sweet_spot_note: Occam's Razor: 3 features (Smoker Status, BMI, Age) account for over 75% of insurance billing variance.
insurance.overfitting_note: Parsimony Tradeoff: Regional dummies contribute marginal predictive lift while adding model parameters.

tsmc_2330.title: 2330.TW: TSMC Stock Price Autoregression (AR) Explorer
tsmc_2330.hero_title: TSMC (2330.TW) Stock Price Autoregression & Time-Lag Parsimony
tsmc_2330.hero_desc: Predict TSMC (2330.TW) daily closing price using multi-lag autoregressive features (Lag 1 to Lag 5). Directly follows AIoT-DA Lecture 6 Topic (a) Autoregression to analyze temporal persistence, Markovian efficiency, and lag decay.
tsmc_2330.sweet_spot_note: Occam's Razor: 1 lag feature(s) achieve optimal out-of-sample RMSE (NT$ 11.74), confirming financial market efficiency where immediate past price captures majority information.
tsmc_2330.overfitting_note: Lag Noise & Overfitting: Extending autoregression to Lag 5 introduces temporal collinearity and increases variance.
